# Environment_Aware_Coordination

## Definition
A method where agent decisions are influenced by persistent, topology-embedded state information rather than explicit message passing. Enables robust operation in dynamic networks, aligning with TCC's focus on in-network computation and iNEST's biologically inspired stigmergy.
